description: This Java source file defines the class InventoryEventPlannedServices, which provides services related to manufacturing resource planning (MRP) events within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for creating and updating MRP events, managing event data, and logging errors.

classes.name: InventoryEventPlannedServices
classes.description: A utility service class providing methods for creating and updating manufacturing resource planning (MRP) events in the Apache OFBiz manufacturing module.

methods.name: createMrpEvent
methods.description: Creates or updates an MRP event based on provided context parameters. It handles exceptions and returns a status map indicating success or error.

methods.name: createOrUpdateMrpEvent
methods.description: Performs the actual creation or update of an MRP event record in the database, aggregating quantities if the event already exists, and updating event details.
